fields.why: Age at introduction is the outcome itself (timing of complementary feeding), so the reported mean of 5.7 months is a continuous summary of the outcome, not a population descriptor; both readers list it in primary_measures. B's binary-only reading is defensible because every test and the headline claims rest on prevalence of early introduction.

brief_issues: Brief could say whether a single reported mean of the outcome's own measure, with no analysis built on it, makes the outcome continuous.
